summary: F1 and F2 are resolved. `IntegrationRegistrationError` keeps the RPC rejection message, duplicate slugs and parse errors become actionable BAD_REQUEST responses, and the duplicate test now tries to point the slug at a different endpoint and verifies that bearer requests still go to the private endpoint. The change is not ready because the durable control-plane run fails: the new OpenApiParseError mapping turns an existing assertion's expected INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR into BAD_REQUEST. Because of that failure, the control-plane coverage is missing, and the import at main.ts:27 is uncovered and has no exemption.

findings.body: The durable run fails here. The test "redeems OAuth setup state once and preserves setups across restart" expects `registerOpenAPI` with `/redirect-spec` to reject with `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`. The new `OpenApiParseError` mapping in IntegrationService.registerOpenAPI (IntegrationService.ts:1065-1071) turns the redirect-blocked fetch failure into an `IntegrationSetupError`, so the RPC now returns BAD_REQUEST ("Failed to fetch OpenAPI document…"). If an actionable BAD_REQUEST is the intended behavior, update this assertion to `{ code: "BAD_REQUEST" }` and check that the message reports the fetch or redirect failure. Otherwise, narrow the mapping so fetch and redirect failures keep their earlier classification. The control-plane coverage for this round is incomplete while this run fails; the IntegrationService.ts lines report as "no test loaded this file".

testRequests.rationale: The new agent-registration durable test already exercises these lines through duplicate and invalid-spec registration. Coverage is missing only because the durable control-plane run failed (F3). Fix F3 so the run passes and records coverage.
